summary: - _(a) To Hold and Declare that the Petitioner has not been able to commission 171.6 MW (connectivity application no. 2200000061) as it is impacted due to occurrence of the Force Majeure Events;_ - _(d) To Declare that the Petitioner’s 171.6 MW Project is entitled for 100% waiver of the inter-state transmission charges._ - _(e) Without prejudice to aforementioned prayers, to Hold and Declare that the Petitioner has liberty to approach this Hon’ble Commission in future upon occurrence of the force majeure events in the future seeking extension of SCOD and waiver of transmission charges for its 171.6 MW Wind-Solar Hybrid project;_ - _(f) Pass such further orders and direct such other consequential relief, including costs of this Petition, as this Hon’ble Commission may deem fit and proper in the nature and circumstance of the case and in the interest of justice._ - _(b) Direct the Respondent not to levy monthly transmission charges for the utilisation of ISTS network (POC charges) from the consumers of the Applicant equivalent to the cumulative capacity of 171.6 MW pending disposal of the accompanying Petition._ - _(c) pass such other order(s) and/ or direction(s) as this Hon’ble Commission may deem just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case._ **3.** The Petitioners have mainly submitted in Petition No. 246/MP/2026 as under: - (n) On the basis of the aforementioned facts and the recommendations issued by the Committee, the Petitioner is seeking declaration and grant of extension and waiver as already recommended by the Committee. - (a) The Petitioner has obtained recommendations from the Committee recommending for - (b) That the Committee has issued the aforesaid recommendation after examining in detail the documents on record and in consideration of the detailed submissions made by the Petitioner justifying the delays in achieving the SCOD of the 171.6 MW capacity of the Project, as the Petitioner was impeded due to the occurrence of various force majeure events which have been duly acknowledged by the Ld. Committee. - (d) The Petitioner is seeking direction from this Commission to direct the Respondent to refrain from levy of ISTS network charges for the power consumed from the capacity of 171.6 MW by the consumers of the Petitioner. _ “The learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that the present Petition has been filed inter alia seeking extension of the Scheduled Date of Commissioning and 100% waiver of inter-State transmission charges, pursuant to the recommendations dated 27.10.2025 and 18.03.2026 issued by the Committee constituted under Regulation 13(2)(h) of the Sharing Regulations, 2020._ _ 2. After hearing the learned counsel for the Petitioner, the Commission directed as under: _ - _ (b) The Respondent to file its reply to the Petition and IA, if any, within two weeks with a copy to the Petitioner, who may file its rejoinder(s), if any, within two weeks thereafter._ - _ (c) The Petitioner was directed to submit the following information on an affidavit within a week: _ - _ (i) The Annexures to the Application dated 08.09.2025 and 16.02.2026, submitted before the Committee._ - _ (iv) The Petitioner has furnished only some pages of the Committee Report dated 27.10.2025 and 18.03.2026. Furnish the complete report of the Committee. _ _ (d) CTUIL is directed to furnish, within a week, an affidavit on the status of the transmission system required for the effectiveness of the connectivity granted to the Petitioner.” _ # ** Submissions of Petitioner in compliance with the RoP for hearing dated 24.06.2026: ** _ “The learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that the present Petition has been filed inter alia seeking extension of the Scheduled Date of Commissioning (SCD) and 100% waiver of the inter-State transmission charges in terms of Reports dated 27.10.2025 and 18.3.2026 of the Committee constituted under Regulation 13(2)(h) of the Sharing Regulations, 2020. The learned counsel submitted that in the said Reports, the Committee recommended extending the SCD of the Petitioner’s Project and a 100% waiver of the ISTS charges. Learned counsel further submitted that CTUIL has also not taken an adversarial stand in the matter and, by its compliance affidavit dated 21.9.2026, it has indicated the status of the transmission system required for the effectiveness of the Petitioner’s connectivity. Accordingly, learned counsel, requested that the matter be reserved for order._ _ 3. Considering the above submissions, the Commission reserved the matter for order.” _ # ** Submissions of Petitioner in compliance with the RoP for hearing dated 22.09.2026: ** **10.** We have considered the submissions of the Petitioner and the Respondent and the documents placed on the record. The following issue arises for our consideration: - _7.1 Based on the submissions, deliberations, and supporting documents, the Committee observes the following:_ _d) These circumstances merit consideration for extension under Regulation 13(2)(h) of the CERC Sharing Regulations, 2020 (as amended)._ **17.** The Petitioner approached the Committee vide its second representation dated _The Committee also notes that the developer expects to complete the remaining balance activities and be ready for commissioning by 30.06.2026._ **22.** We observe that Petitioner has also prayed that in case of delay in commissioning of CTS beyond 30.06.2026, the project SCOD be further extended till the commissioning of the CTS Line required for evacuation of the power from its project and also to align the start date of connectivity with such extended date. In this regard, in the absence of any provision under the 2020 Sharing Regulations, the reliefs sought by the Petitioner are rejected. **23.** The Petition No. 246/MP/2026 along with 82/IA/2026 stands disposed of in terms of the above. No order as to costs.
title: Petition under Section 79 (1) (c) and (k) of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with Regulation 27 and 28 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Sharing of Inter-State Transmission Charges and Losses) Regulations, 2020 and read with the reports issued by the Report Recommending Extension of Scheduled Date of Commissioning, Start Date of Connectivity and the consequential waiver of 100% inter-state transmission charges by the Committee formed under Regulation 13(2)(h) of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Sharing of Inter-State Transmission Charges and Losses) Regulations, 2020 for seeking extension of Scheduled of Commission and 100% waiver of the inter-state transmission charges.
